description: This file defines a custom view class 'LabelView' that extends Android's View. It provides methods to set text, text size, and text color, and handles drawing text onto the canvas. It includes constructors for instantiation via code or XML layout, and overrides measurement and drawing methods to render the label appropriately.

classes.name: LabelView
classes.description: A custom Android View subclass that displays a single line of text, with configurable text content, size, and color. It handles measuring and rendering the text within the view.

methods.name: LabelView
methods.description: Constructor for programmatic instantiation of LabelView with context.

methods.name: LabelView
methods.description: Constructor for instantiation from XML, retrieves custom attributes and initializes the view.

methods.description: Sets the text content to be displayed and requests layout update.

methods.description: Sets the size of the text font and requests layout update.

methods.name: setTextColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the text.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view dimensions based on the text and padding.

methods.description: Calculates the width of the view based on content and spec.
